Latest publicationValve mechanobiology

Mechano-sensing channels PIEZO1 and PIEZO2 regulate mitral valve serotonin-mediated homeostasis and pathophysiology

Stachelek S.J., Hauber E.J., Yang X., Laurence D.W., Rusinkevich V., Lu P., et al.

Cardiovascular Research · cvag190 · Published online September 3, 2026 (accepted manuscript)

Read paper ↗BibTeX ↓
Research summary

This study examines PIEZO1 and PIEZO2 in human mitral valves and cultured valve interstitial cells. The findings connect mechanosensing with serotonin transport, receptor signaling, and collagen synthesis under static and cyclic tension conditions.
